Team,

Attached is the final scoring worksheet for Q4 (q4_okr_scoring_sheet.xlsx) plus my running notes (score_comments.pdf). We ran the first pass in the scoring session last week; this thread is to lock the final marks and agree the exec-facing narrative and comms slate. High-level asks:  

- Internal: please review your assigned objectives and any "contested" flags by EOD Oct 2 (Irene/Ben especially on platform metrics).
- External/Legal: Akash and LegalOps, FYI on any evidence links you need — we'll publish the exec summary once scores are locked.

A couple of known items:
- Platform latency (OBJ-123): there are two contested marks where engineering is arguing for a partial credit due to a rollout window. Evidence is noted in score_comments.pdf.
- Expansion motion (OBJ-201): Acorn KPIs are included for reference; Akash flagged a data refresh on Sept 29.

My plan: compile final changes on Oct 3 by noon, then circulate the executive one-pager for signoff. If there are material disputes, we'll escalate to Vivek for arbitration.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

- Keep the executive one-pager strictly to outcomes + evidence bullets. Avoid metric-level debate in the exec doc; include a link to the scoring workbook for anyone who wants details.

I'll step in on any unresolved OBJ-123 disputes. For scheduling: feed the final spreadsheet to me by 11:30am PT Oct 3 and I'll approve or escalate by 1pm.

Folks — I reviewed the sheet and left inline notes in score_comments.pdf. Summary of my asks:  

- OBJ-123 (Platform latency): propose adjusting from 7/10 to 8/10. Rationale: rollout window (Sept 20–26) where we had controlled degradation for canary; most customers were routed to the fallback variant, so customer-facing error budget impact is lower than the raw SLO breach implies. Evidence: internal canary logs and incident postmortem (linked in comments).
- OBJ-178 (SLA adoption): drop one point — the enterprise enablement timeline slipped 2 weeks, change logged in the workbook.

I included a redline view in page 3 of score_comments.pdf and highlighted which items need an explicit note in the exec appendix. If Akash can confirm the Sept 29 snapshot for OBJ-201, I will accept the uplift.

Irene

- I've produced the one-page exec summary (attached as PDF in the Drive link) and queued the comms slate for distribution to execs and managers tomorrow morning.
